How Close Are We to Quantum Batteries? Shop Micro Center's Back to School Savings: https://micro.center/b02440 Sign up for a FREE 128 gig flash drive at Micro Center Austin: https://micro.center/a42442 Sign up for a FREE 128 gig flash drive at Micro Center Columbus: https://micro.center/d06603 Check out AI at Micro Center: https://micro.center/2bd199 Bigger batteries take longer to charge. Right? Researchers in Australia just tested one that flips that rule completely. The larger they built it, the faster it charged. It runs on quantum effects, and the very first version charged with light from a laser, no cord required. Scientists call the ultra fast charging trick superabsorption, and it hints at energy storage that could one day power your phone or car. So is this quantum battery actually the future of charging? Or is it just a lab curiosity that fizzles out in nanoseconds?
